metric definition / evidence: mean over the 4 WOA quarters of the % of 60-90N ocean area with >=10 T profiles at 500 m; by quarter: JFM 25%, AMJ 26%, JAS 36%, OND 33%
comment: Needs large influence radii/smoothing; unconstrained in many boxes in at least one season.

purpose: Regional climatology of the Atlantic layer (north of 70N)
metric definition / evidence: % of ocean area >70N with >=10 profiles at 300 m (all years); 35,610 central-Arctic profiles reach >=200 m
comment: Best in Eurasian Basin and Nordic seas where drifting-platform and ship profiles are dense.

metric definition / evidence: % of 60-90N ocean area with >=10 profiles at 2000 m (denominator includes shelves shallower than 2000 m, so a lower bound); 38,865 profiles (9.4%) have data below 1500 m
comment: Deep data come mostly from ship CTD casts, mainly summer; Argo-like profiles stop at ~2000 m.

metric definition / evidence: mean over quarters of % ocean area with >=10 profiles at 10 m (0 m is empty, 5 m partly filled); by quarter: JFM 36%, AMJ 36%, JAS 58%, OND 47%
comment: 0 m is empty and 5 m only ~67% filled; summer/ice-free sampling bias dominates.

metric definition / evidence: % ocean area with >=10 S profiles at 100 m (all years)
comment: Best-covered layer; fine vertical spacing, many INFERRED ITP-like profiles in the basins after 2004.

metric definition / evidence: % ocean area sampled in >=10 distinct years (not accounting for profiles per year or season)
comment: Coverage shifts from sparse ship sections to drifting platforms and Argo, changing place and season.

purpose: Seasonal cycle in the central Arctic
metric definition / evidence: % of calendar months with >=100 central-Arctic profiles reaching >=200 m from >=10 distinct years; 12 of 12 months pass
comment: Passes the count rule, but only 2.2% of central-Arctic profiles predate 2003; winter months rest on only ~15 years (mostly drifting platforms), so interannual and seasonal signals are confounded.

purpose: Eulerian time series at a point
metric definition / evidence: % ocean area in 100 km boxes with >=100 profiles, >=10 years, >=6 calendar months; INFERRED fixed-point series: 32
comment: Only few locations; most data are drifting or one-off stations.

metric definition / evidence: % of 1 deg ocean cells north of 60N with >=10 profiles (all years, all depths)
comment: Subsample the model at the data locations/times instead of comparing with the mean state.

metric definition / evidence: % ocean area with >=10 profiles reaching >=700 m (all years); by decade: 1983-1992 7%, 1993-2002 13%, 2003-2012 32%, 2013-2023 32%
comment: Needs profiles that reach 700 m; shallow drifting-platform profiles reduce effective coverage.
